classification.difficultyReason: Combine adjacent angles, apply exact tangent values in two right-angled triangles, then subtract lengths and simplify surds.

spec.description: Unshaded nested right triangles with horizontal AB, vertical BD, C between B and D, and a curved pointer identifying the 15° sector.
spec.mathematics: AB=10; angle BAC=45°; angle CAD=15°; angle ABD=90°; CD=x. Coordinates derive BC=10 and BD=10√3 without displaying these answers.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, point names and the unknown x appear.

answer.worked:
$\angle BAD=45^\circ+15^\circ=60^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}
\tan60^\circ&=\frac{BD}{10}\\
BD&=10\tan60^\circ\\
BD&=10\sqrt{3}\\
\tan45^\circ&=\frac{BC}{10}\\
BC&=10\tan45^\circ\\
BC&=10\\
x&=BD-BC\\
x&=10\sqrt{3}-10\\
x&=10(\sqrt{3}-1).
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded nested right triangles with a 30° lower sector and a curved pointer identifying the adjacent 15° sector.
spec.mathematics: AB=10; angle BAC=30°; angle CAD=15°; angle ABD=90°; CD=x. Coordinates derive BC=10/√3 and BD=10 without displaying these answers.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, point names and the unknown x appear.

answer.worked:
$\angle BAD=30^\circ+15^\circ=45^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}
\tan45^\circ&=\frac{BD}{10}\\
BD&=10\tan45^\circ\\
BD&=10\\
\tan30^\circ&=\frac{BC}{10}\\
BC&=10\tan30^\circ\\
BC&=\frac{10}{\sqrt{3}}\\
x&=BD-BC\\
x&=10-\frac{10}{\sqrt{3}}\\
x&=10-\frac{10\sqrt{3}}{3}\\
x&=\frac{10}{3}(3-\sqrt{3}).
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded nested right triangles with two adjacent 30° sectors at A.
spec.mathematics: AB=10; angle BAC=30°; angle CAD=30°; angle ABD=90°; CD=x. Coordinates derive BC=10/√3 and BD=10√3 without displaying these answers.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, point names and the unknown x appear.

answer.worked:
$\angle BAD=30^\circ+30^\circ=60^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}
\tan60^\circ&=\frac{BD}{10}\\
BD&=10\tan60^\circ\\
BD&=10\sqrt{3}\\
\tan30^\circ&=\frac{BC}{10}\\
BC&=10\tan30^\circ\\
BC&=\frac{10}{\sqrt{3}}\\
x&=BD-BC\\
x&=10\sqrt{3}-\frac{10}{\sqrt{3}}\\
x&=10\sqrt{3}-\frac{10\sqrt{3}}{3}\\
x&=\frac{20\sqrt{3}}{3}.
\end{align*}$$
